previous_state.description: ZQK is the Cognitive Substrate for Hybrid AI-Human Engineering. It replaces stateless, amnesiac prompt-and-pray development with a graph-backed, spec-driven knowledge kernel that never forgets and never hallucinates its architectural boundaries.
